Where does each graph cross the axes? Where is tangent undefined?

<p class="booklet-cue">Booklet pp. 1–3 · Examples 1.1–1.3: visual recap</p>

::: notes

Prerequisite recap only, about one minute. All graphs are in radians on −2π≤x≤2π. Sine has zeros at integer multiples of π. Cosine has y-intercept 1 and zeros at odd multiples of π/2. Tangent has zeros at integer multiples of π and vertical asymptotes at π/2+kπ. Do not introduce the new vocabulary on this slide or spend time re-sketching all three graphs. The complete sketches are supporting illustrations, not extra assigned booklet tasks.

:::
